summary.text: Lonnie Randolph is a Democrat who has represented Indiana Senate District 2, which includes East Chicago, Whiting, Munster, Hammond and portions of Highland in Lake County, since he was elected in 1992.
He is a founding partner of Randolph and Randolph, P.C.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Democrats biography, Randolph holds a Juris Doctor degree from John Marshall Law School.
He was elected Freshman Legislator of the Year by fellow legislators in his first year in office and received a 2009 appreciation from the Minority Health Coalition.
The page says he lives in East Chicago with his wife and has two children and two grandchildren.
